narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The fifth stroke goes beside the other four.
<bookmark mark='same'/>Then five strokes look like four, and we must count them one by one.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The fifth stroke crosses the four, so each group of five is seen at once.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check your own table, add the counts of all six rows.
<bookmark mark='total'/>The total must be exactly the number of times you rolled the die.
